Privacy

What this preview handles, and what it does not.

The public static files do not send an inquiry or activate email, phone, WhatsApp or analytics. A separate loopback-only M2 server can test synthetic inquiry delivery locally.

Static websiteLocal inquiry testStockroomAccess and erasureDecisions before launch

Static website

The static preview serves local fonts, images, styles and scripts. It has no analytics or advertising tracker. Contact channels remain disabled because ownership, monitoring, receipt and reply have not been verified.

Local synthetic inquiry test

When the M2 test server is running on this computer, its inquiry page accepts synthetic test details only. It validates and stores them in a local SQLite queue outside the public site. The fake delivery adapter records delivered or failed status; it does not send email, WhatsApp or any network message.

The test records contain the submitted fields, request ID, status and timestamps. Logs contain request IDs and status, not message content. Local evidence is retained for this milestone review and can be removed through the documented local cleanup procedure after review.

Stockroom browser records

Stockroom can save inventory records in this browser and device. They are not encrypted or synced. Clearing browser data may remove them; downloaded backups remain the visitor’s responsibility. Avoid shared devices and personal or sensitive records.

Access and erasure procedure

During local testing, the reviewer can use a request ID to inspect a synthetic record through the local test evidence tools. The local administrator can delete milestone test storage after evidence is preserved. There is no public deletion endpoint in this phase.

Decisions required before real inquiries

Owner approval is still required for the lawful basis, retention period, inbox and processors, any international transfer safeguards, access/erasure operating procedure and the final customer notice. This draft is implementation evidence, not legal advice or launch approval.
